claim: With save_queries off, no question-and-answer patterns are written anywhere, while SQL Lens still reads patterns already in memory.
source_excerpt: When off, no question-and-answer patterns are written, and SQL Lens still reads any patterns already in memory.
verify_against: every write path to question-and-answer patterns: the factory's save_queries gate and the curated import path
verify_hint: Check the `save_queries` gate in `src/sqllens/agent/factory.py` against `add_sql_pair`/`save_tool_usage` in `src/sqllens/memory/store.py` and the `save_queries` row in `docs/external/configuration.md`
prior_evidence: The agent-side gate holds: factory.py:126-127 registers SaveQuestionToolArgsTool (the only agent caller of save_tool_usage, tools/agent_memory.py:90) only when cfg.memory.save_queries; search tool is read-only and registered always. But the doc sentence at configuration.md:81 is unqualified ('no question-and-answer patterns are written'). The curated import path memory/store.py:108-116 (add_sql_pair -> save_tool_usage) is not gated by save_queries, and the same doc says sqllens import-memory works regardless (lines 83, 88) and admin 'add' exists (84). So with save_queries off, patterns can still be written via import. Line 71/82 qualify this for notes ('SQL Lens writes these itself', 'of its own') but line 81 does not, so the absolute wording is inaccurate. Narrow doc-wording defect; the agent's own saving is correctly off.
